items.t: Jumia Technologies Analysts Slash Their Forecasts Following Q3 Results
items.sum: Jumia's Q3 revenue jumped 33% to $60.7M, beating estimates, but it cut 2026 guidance. Shares fell 10.8%; analysts lowered price targets.

items.t: StoneX Maintains Buy on Jumia Technologies, Lowers Price Target to $13
items.sum: StoneX analyst Fawne Jiang maintains Jumia Technologies (NYSE:JMIA) with a Buy and lowers the price target from $18 to $13.

items.t: Cantor Fitzgerald Maintains Overweight on Jumia Technologies, Lowers Price Target to $5
items.sum: Cantor Fitzgerald analyst Deepak Mathivanan maintains Jumia Technologies (NYSE:JMIA) with a Overweight and lowers the price target from $9 to $5.
